NSNCD_WORKER_COUNT.description: Number of worker threads nsncd will spawn to process requests.

NSNCD_HANDOFF_TIMEOUT.description: Number of seconds nsncd will wait for a worker thread to become available.

NSNCD_IGNORE_GROUP.description: If set to "true", nsncd will not respond to requests for the group database.

NSNCD_IGNORE_HOSTS.description: If set to "true", nsncd will not respond to requests for the hosts database.

NSNCD_IGNORE_INITGROUPS.description: If set to "true", nsncd will not respond to requests for the initgroups database.

NSNCD_IGNORE_NETGROUP.description: If set to "true", nsncd will not respond to requests for the netgroup database.

NSNCD_IGNORE_PASSWD.description: If set to "true", nsncd will not respond to requests for the passwd database.

NSNCD_IGNORE_SERVICES.description: If set to "true", nsncd will not respond to requests for the services database.
